title: Human-aligned gloss judgments in frozen vision-language models: code and figure reproduction
description: Prepared source release containing original code, experimental configurations and compact inputs for reproducing six main figures, supplementary figures S1-S15 and tables S1-S9. Shaobing Gao and Minjie Tan contributed equally. Shaobing Gao is the corresponding author (gaoshaobing@scu.edu.cn). Full raw responses and full activation arrays are separate data-release components. The MIT license applies only to original project code; third-party code, stimulus images, human data, environment maps and other research assets retain their original rights and notices, as detailed in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md. GitHub repository: https://github.com/jackygsb/human-aligned-gloss. This repository is currently in private preparation. This file remains proposed software-package metadata, not the actual metadata or access settings of the separate full-data draft. Zenodo full-data draft 23309081 exists and uploads/checksum verification are in progress. Its reserved DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23309081 is not registered, published or available as a released citation. The archived GitHub source snapshot is fixed to commit c0f8da12a3bdb3fe7bc3cb4ff49eaf7a2abc3083.
